approval_basis: 2026-10-11 用户显性批准上述6项精细诊断：190/170m各H0/H1局部快照，2.5cm输出，0–550ns、120–440ns每9步其余17步、31处全2400ns时序及Yee邻点；另170m H0/H1全域20cm每17步至2400ns；现行物理/SFCW不变，先验收170m局部H1，失败停止不重试，新批3小时；配套代码、验收、图件和推送。
collocation: Raw node E; mean staggered H neighbours and H[n],H[n+1]. Snapshot cell centres independently reproduced by positive native neighbours.
limits: Observer-only 6 cases, not new spatial line. Snapshot temporal sampling does not certify broadband impulse bandwidth. Complete native probes are used for exact501-tone checks. Total E cross H is net flux, not unique rays/bounce energies or dispersive energy closure. No 3D, mesh/time-length convergence or field calibration.
